description: The complete recovery action menu. The Diagnosis LLM may select ONLY from these ids; anything else is rejected in code and falls back deterministically.

actions.label: Retry on alternate instrument
actions.detail: Payment link steering the customer to a different method (e.g. card failed -> offer UPI).

actions.label: Retry same instrument after cooldown
actions.detail: Payment link for the same method, sent only after the 30-minute cooldown.

actions.label: Recovery nudge
actions.detail: Payment link with a short Hinglish nudge message for abandoned checkouts.

actions.label: Offer EMI / lower-friction option
actions.detail: Payment link framed around EMI/instalments for high-value declines.

actions.label: Escalate to human
actions.detail: No API call. Writes an escalation record with a mandatory reason.
